Marriage Certificate — Registration Guide

• Last updated: 2026-09-15 · 3 min read
Share:
In simple words:

Marriage Certificate ek legal document hai jo do logon ki marriage ko government ke saath register karta hai. Yeh proof of marriage hai aur passport, visa, bank joint accounts, property, aur legal rights ke liye zaroori hai.

S
Samjho Content Team ✓

Trusted and policy experts simplifying MSME, tax, and compliance for India. Verified by Chartered Accountants.

Simple explanation

Marriage Certificate ek official document hai jo prove karta hai ki do logon ki marriage legally registered hai. India mein marriage registration 2 laws ke under ho sakta hai: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 (Hindus, Sikhs, Jains, Buddhists ke liye) aur Special Marriage Act, 1954 (kisi bhi religion ke liye).

Register karne ke liye aap apne state / district ke marriage registration portal par online apply kar sakte hain ya nearest SDM / Tehsil / Marriage Registrar office mein. Dono partners ko physically present rehna hota hai (kuch states mein exceptions hain).

Required documents: Dono partners ka Aadhaar / ID proof, age proof (birth certificate / 10th marksheet — groom 21+, bride 18+), marriage photo, wedding invitation card, 2-3 witnesses ke ID proof aur photos, aur address proof.

Hindu Marriage Act ke under registration bride ke residence area mein hota hai jahan marriage hui. Special Marriage Act ke under 30 din ka notice period hota hai — public notice lagti hai, objections invite hoti hain. Fees ₹100-₹500 (state-wise vary).

Why does it matter?

Marriage certificate sirf ek formality nahi — yeh legal rights establish karta hai. Spouse ke saath property rights, pension / insurance nomination, joint bank account, passport mein spouse name add karna, foreign visa (dependent visa), aur legal separation / divorce cases mein — sabke liye marriage certificate zaroori hai.

Example

In numbers

Aapki shaadi hui hai aur aap wife ke passport mein spouse name add karna chahte hain. Passport office marriage certificate maangta hai. Aap state marriage portal par jaake online apply karte hain — dono ki details, wedding photos, witnesses ki details upload karte hain. SDM office mein dono partners + witnesses physically jaate hain. 15-30 din mein marriage certificate mil jaata hai.

Important things to know

  • Marriage registration 2 acts ke under ho sakta hai: Hindu Marriage Act (1955) aur Special Marriage Act (1954).
  • Hindu Marriage Act: Hindus, Sikhs, Jains, Buddhists ke liye. Special Marriage Act: Kisi bhi religion ke liye.
  • Minimum age: Groom 21 years, Bride 18 years. Under-age marriage illegal hai.
  • Required documents: ID proof, age proof, marriage photos, wedding invitation, witnesses ke ID + photos.
  • Witnesses: Kam se kam 2-3 witnesses zaroori hain jo marriage ceremony mein present the.
  • HMA ke under: 15-30 din mein certificate milta hai. SMA ke under: 30 din notice period + registration.
  • Fees: ₹100-₹500 (state-wise vary). Tatkaal option kuch states mein available hai (extra fees).
  • Online + Offline dono option hain — online apply karke SDM office mein physically jaana hota hai final verification ke liye.

Common mistakes

  • Marriage registration delay karna — jitna jaldi register karoge utna aasan. Saalon baad mein witnesses milna mushkil ho sakta hai.
  • Witnesses ko saath na le jaana — SDM office mein witnesses physically present hone chahiye apne original ID proof ke saath.
  • Age proof mein discrepancy — bride/groom ki age documents mein exactly match honi chahiye (groom 21+, bride 18+).
  • Galat jurisdiction mein apply karna — marriage registration bride ke area mein hota hai jahan marriage hui ya jahan woh rehti hai.
  • Wedding invitation card na rakhna — yeh marriage date aur venue ka supporting proof hota hai, bahut kaam aata hai.

Frequently asked questions

Marriage certificate ke liye online apply kaise karein?

Apne state / district ke marriage registration portal par jaayein. 'Register Marriage' form bharein — groom aur bride ki details, marriage date, place, witnesses. Documents upload karein, fees pay karein. SDM / Marriage Registrar office mein appointment lein jahan dono partners + witnesses physically jaayein.

Marriage certificate ke liye kaunse documents lagte hain?

Groom aur bride ka Aadhaar / ID proof, age proof (birth certificate / 10th marksheet / passport), marriage photos (wedding ceremony ki), wedding invitation card, address proof, aur 2-3 witnesses ke ID proof + photos. Sab documents original + photocopy le jaayein.

Hindu Marriage Act aur Special Marriage Act mein kya farak hai?

Hindu Marriage Act: Sirf Hindus, Sikhs, Jains, Buddhists ke liye. No notice period, direct registration. Special Marriage Act: Kisi bhi religion ke liye. 30 din ka public notice period hota hai — objections invite hoti hain. Inter-faith marriages ke liye SMA use hota hai.

Marriage certificate kitne din mein banta hai?

Hindu Marriage Act ke under: 15-30 din (documents complete hone ke baad). Special Marriage Act ke under: 30 din notice period + registration = total 30-45 din. Tatkaal option kuch states mein hai jisme 7 din mein mil sakta hai (extra fees).

Marriage registration ki fees kitni hai?

Normal registration: ₹100-₹500 (state-wise vary). Tatkaal / urgent: ₹1,000-₹5,000. Kuch states mein fees maaf hai ya nominal hai. Online payment ho sakta hai ya office mein cash. Latest fees apne state portal par check karein.

Kya bina witnesses ke marriage certificate ban sakta hai?

Nahi. Witnesses mandatory hain — kam se kam 2-3 witnesses chahiye jo marriage ceremony mein present the. Witnesses ko apne original ID proof ke saath SDM office mein physically jaana hota hai. Bina witnesses ke registration complete nahi hota.

Inter-faith marriage ka registration kaise hoga?

Inter-faith (different religion) marriage ke liye Special Marriage Act ke under register karna padta hai. 30 din ka public notice period hota hai. Dono partners ki details, documents, witnesses lagte hain. Koi religious conversion zaroori nahi hai SMA ke under.
